name: Meerschaum
look: a creamy ivory stone gargoyle carved like an ornate meerschaum pipe, with an amber patina, a pipe-bowl back and wings
entry: Artisans carve Meerschaum into intricate shapes. The darker and richer its golden-brown coloration, the older and more powerful the Pokémon is.
how: Wild: rare in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Patina Polish raises its Defense and Sp. Def whenever a Fire- or Poison-type move hits it.
